name: GL5528
description: GL5528 CdS photoresistor (Senba GL55 series): R = 15 kOhm x (E / 10 lx)^-0.6, each part's 10-lux resistance drawn inside the datasheet's 10-20 kOhm, at least 1 MOhm in darkness; reads the world's illuminance while its own is not set.

law.doc: Resistance law. This entry selects the illuminance power law.

r_ref.doc: Resistance at the reference illuminance: 15 kOhm, the middle of the datasheet's 10-20 kOhm at 10 lux (GL55 series, GL5528), each part drawn inside ±tolerance (ADR-034).

lux_ref.doc: Illuminance at which r_ref is specified.

gamma.doc: Exponent in R = r_ref * (illuminance / lux_ref)^(-gamma): the datasheet's gamma between 10 and 100 lux for the GL5528, 0.6.

r_dark.doc: Resistance in darkness: the datasheet's minimum dark resistance, 1 MOhm (10 s after the light goes); it also caps the low-light power law.

tolerance.doc: Spread of the light resistance: the datasheet gives 10-20 kOhm at 10 lux, ±33 % around 15 kOhm; each part is drawn from the project's seed (ADR-034); 0 for the nominal.

inputs.name: illuminance
inputs.doc: External environment; change live while running; read from the world's illuminance while not set

electrical.claims: The GL55 datasheet's light law for the GL5528: 10-20 kOhm at 10 lux (each part drawn from the seed), gamma 0.6 between 10 and 100 lux, 1 MOhm dark resistance as the cap.
omissions: response time (the datasheet's 20 ms rise, 30 ms decay): the resistance follows the illuminance at once

sources.title: GL55 family reference; manufacturer revision and numerical fit unverified
sources.notes: ECAD lead numbers; nonpolar device. Nominal educational fit, not an extracted manufacturer model.
